## NUMERIC multiplication and division

# NUMERIC is exact to nine fractional digits over 29 integer digits, so a quotient or product in
# that range keeps every digit.
SELECT NUMERIC '12345678901234567.123456789' / NUMERIC '1'
=> "12345678901234567.123456789"

SELECT x / 4 FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '99999999999999999999999999999.999999996']) x
=> "24999999999999999999999999999.999999999"

SELECT NUMERIC '10000000000' * NUMERIC '10000000000'
=> "100000000000000000000"

SELECT x * x FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '-0.000123456']) x
=> "0.000000015"

SELECT NUMERIC '99999999999999999999999999999.999999999' * -1
=> "-99999999999999999999999999999.999999999"

SELECT SAFE_DIVIDE(NUMERIC '12345678901234567.123456789', 1)
=> "12345678901234567.123456789"

# BigQuery's answers: results beyond nine fractional digits round half away from zero.
SELECT NUMERIC '2' / 3
=> "0.666666667"

SELECT NUMERIC '-2' / 3
=> "-0.666666667"

SELECT NUMERIC '1' / NUMERIC '2000000000'
=> "0.000000001"

SELECT NUMERIC '3' / NUMERIC '2000000000'
=> "0.000000002"

SELECT NUMERIC '0.000000001' * NUMERIC '0.5'
=> "0.000000001"

SELECT NUMERIC '-0.000000003' * NUMERIC '0.5'
=> "-0.000000002"

# BigQuery's answers: overflow and division by zero fail with these messages.
SELECT NUMERIC '99999999999999999999999999999' * 10
=> error contains: numeric overflow: 99999999999999999999999999999 * 10

SELECT NUMERIC '1e20' / NUMERIC '1e-9'
=> error contains: numeric overflow: 100000000000000000000 / 0.000000001

SELECT NUMERIC '1' / 0
=> error contains: division by zero: 1 / 0

# BigQuery mathematical_functions#safe_divide: NULL where division fails.
SELECT SAFE_DIVIDE(NUMERIC '1', 0)
=> null

SELECT SAFE_DIVIDE(NUMERIC '1e20', NUMERIC '1e-9')
=> null

SELECT NUMERIC '1' / CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC)
=> null

SELECT CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) * 2
=> null

SELECT SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC), 0)
=> null

SELECT IF(FALSE, NUMERIC '1' / 0, NUMERIC '2')
=> "2"
